newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Salmon shrholders approve Chilean sale.
newsitem.headline: NZ Salmon shrholders approve Chilean sale.

text.p: The New Zealand Salmon Company Ltd said on Tuesday a meeting of shareholders unanimously approved the sale of the company's Chilean interests.
Shareholders were also unanimously agreed to the sell-down of shares in listed Chilean company Mainstream, which will be received for the sale of NZ Salmon's Chilean interests.
Chairman Ian Farrant recorded not only unanimous approval by shareholders, but proxy support of approximately 80 percent of all shares.
The company will know on August 1 whether Mainstream will exercise its option.
